pkgmetadata.longdescription: kubeconform is a Kubernetes manifest validator that schema-checks YAML or JSON manifests against the OpenAPI-derived JSON Schemas for a target Kubernetes version. Faster successor to the now-abandoned kubeval, it handles CustomResourceDefinitions via configurable schema locations and is the de-facto modern answer for the "validate manifests in pre-commit or CI" use case. Pure Go, single static binary, Apache-2.0.
